title: Overlapping shifts on the schedule
owner: Synthetic evaluation fixture (test-only; not CDIT policy)

sections.heading: Two shifts overlap on the schedule
sections.text: When two shifts overlap on a User's schedule, Staff record both shifts and hand the conflict to an Admin for human review. Staff do not move, cancel, or swap shifts.

steps.text: Ask the User to open My Schedule and read the date, start time, and end time of both shifts.
Record both shifts exactly as the schedule shows them, and the time zone shown on the page.

information_needed.prompt: Date, start time, and end time of both shifts, as shown on the schedule.

stop_conditions.text: If the times look shifted by several hours, the overlap may be a time zone display difference; share KB-SCH-150 before handing on a conflict.
Staff do not change the schedule. Hand the conflict to an Admin for human review.
